rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Tiny 11 m kerb on busy Hawken Drive, signed bus and loading zone.
reasons: Bus zone and loading zone signs

drivers.seclusion: Dwelling 10 m (at 5 m) and 13-15 m away; church and houses overlook the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a bus stop apron beside a through lane; stretch is only 11 m, shorter than a van with room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with a junction and signals nearby.
drivers.convention: Bus zone and school loading zone signs cover this kerb.

flags: Bus zone and passenger loading zone signs
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the middle of the stretch, partly shading it.

best_section.where: Hawken Drive west kerb, beside the uniting church and bus stop
